discarded_incomplete_matrix.rule: The adjacent CONTROL and DUAL_APPEND pair is one indivisible matrix segment. A pure implementation fault in DUAL_APPEND discards both paths without using either economic outcome.

evidence: The lifecycle was created by the normal market-entry path at server 2024.05.10 17:00:00, not recovery or restart adoption.

WaitForEntryDealAggregation invokes AggregateEntryDeals with sampled_tick_known=true for a normal submitted market entry, so aggregate.cost_known remains true and SeedProvisionalMarketLifecycle persists entry_cost_known=true.
No EA reinitialization occurred between this OPEN and CLOSE.

Within the source, no active-lifecycle path can change only entry_cost_known to false; ClearEntryTracking would also clear the identifier, volume and direction and would have failed earlier exit-state checks.
ApplyExitDeal reached complete_cost=false after entry identity, direction and volume validation while entry_cost_known was true.
The structurally valid pre-submit US500 quote exceeded the fixed three-second freshness classification, otherwise sampled_tick_known would already have made exit_quote_known true.

The standard CopyTicksRange lookup found no valid US500 bid/ask within plus or minus five seconds of the foreign-symbol deal timestamp, otherwise QuoteAtMilliseconds would have made exit_quote_known true.
The broker/tester nevertheless filled the long-position exit at 5218.02, exactly the pre-submit bid used for that sell-side exit.

diagnosis.root_cause: The accounting layer treated a stale-classified foreign-symbol pre-submit quote as unusable even when the completed deal itself proved that its actionable side was the exact execution quote. This was an evidence-classification defect after execution, not a signal, order, hold, risk, stop or market-price defect.

includes: both HTML reports and report graphs
both path state, event, current and lock outputs

correction.scope: After the existing fresh-sampled and exact-time-history quote paths both fail, accept the already captured structurally valid pre-submit quote only when the completed exit deal's execution price equals the directionally actionable sampled bid or ask within max(1e-8, tick_size*1e-6).
correction.fail_closed_preserved: A missing, invalid or nonmatching sampled quote still leaves cost incomplete and engages the existing safety stop.
correction.audit_log: Each accepted fallback emits one bounded execution-matched exit-quote recovery log row with component, deal and sampled/deal millisecond timestamps.

matrix_action: Commit and push the refrozen correction and environment, remove only active Unit 093 runtime outputs after preservation, then restart all four declared paths from BINDING_LONG CONTROL. No selective path patch or result reuse is allowed.
